body:
Added SteamAppID: os.Getenv("D2_STEAM_APPID") to internal/games/games.go's Registry["d2"] entry, matching the deadweight entry's exact pattern (env-gated, empty by default, gates steam-login 404 the same honest way). Confirmed generic consumption via game_online.go's steamLogin handler (keyed by games.Config, not hardcoded per-game) -- no other wiring needed. Extended the d2 entry's existing comment block explaining why BotPerm/CheckpointsWritePerm/CheckpointBlobDir/TicketsWritePerm are still deliberately omitted (D4 bot not built, no checkpoint/ticket economy server exists) while SteamAppID is safe to add now (env toggle, no server dependency). go build ./... and go test ./... clean from /home/fatbaby/IDUNA.

⚓ ☃
title: d2: add SteamAppID parity field to games.Registry
